meta.description: The grog-soaked beer pong tourney o' the Pharmazentrum at the University o' Basel, arrr!

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Arrr, ye must come aboard first!
errors.FORBIDDEN: Ye don't have the captain's leave for that, matey.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Nowhere to be found on the map.
errors.STALE_VERSION: Another scallywag changed this just now. The chart's been redrawn. Check it and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE: Can't do that in these waters, matey.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: That change o' course isn't allowed.
errors.TOURNAMENT_PAUSED: The armada be anchored for now.
errors.TEAM_BUSY: One o' the crews be sailin' at another table.
errors.TABLE_BUSY: A battle be already rollin' at this table.
errors.TEAM_FULL: This crew be full to the brim.
errors.ALREADY_IN_TEAM: Ye already sail with a crew.
errors.ROSTER_LOCKED: Crews be locked. Only the ship's officers can change them now.
errors.INVALID_INVITE: That invite code be cursed. It's invalid.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: Another crew already flies that name.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: A pirate with that email address already be aboard.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email or password be wrong, ye scurvy dog.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries! Wait a few minutes, *hic*.
errors.WRONG_TEAM_COUNT: The draw needs exactly 12 full crews.
errors.GROUPS_INCOMPLETE: Not every group battle has been confirmed yet.
errors.UNRESOLVED_TIE: A tie in the group must be settled with a shootout first.
errors.DOWNSTREAM_STARTED: Later battles have already begun. Only the recovery wizard can fix this.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request was already sent with different cargo.
errors.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm the deed with the requested words, matey.
errors.UPLOAD_INVALID: Hoist a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 1 MB.
errors.WRONG_MODE: Can't do that in the current game mode.
errors.PLAYER_BUSY: Somebody in the line-up be fightin' another match.
errors.SESSION_NOT_OPEN: The Elo session isn't takin' new matches right now.
errors.MODE_SWITCH_BLOCKED: The game mode can only change once all open matches be done.
errors.ROSTER_CHANGED: The line-up changed while ye weren't lookin'. Check it and confirm again.
errors.INTERNAL: Shiver me timbers, something broke! Try again.

specific.eventCodeWrong: That event code be wrong, matey.
specific.linkInvalid: That link be invalid or has rotted away.
specific.teamNameLength: The crew name must be {min}–{max} characters long.
specific.mottoTooLong: The motto can be {max} characters at most.
specific.teamDissolved: This crew has been scattered to the winds.
specific.checkInOnlyDuringRegistration: Checkin' in only works while signin' up be open.
specific.personNotInTeam: That sailor isn't in the crew.
specific.samePerson: The old and new sailor be the same.
specific.cannotDissolveAfterGroups: Crews can't be scattered once the group battles begin.
specific.alreadyDrawn: The crew has already been drawn into a group.
specific.unknownPlayer: Unknown or banished sailor in the line-up.
specific.onlyOwnMatches: Ye can only start battles ye fight in yerself.
specific.pickUnconfirmedTeam: Pick a crew that hasn't confirmed yet.

validation.emailTooLong: That email address be too long.
validation.emailInvalid: Enter a proper email address, matey.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in quick, then back to the grog deck with ye, *hic*.
login.forgot: Forgot yer password? The tournament officers can hand ye a reset link.

register.title: Register
register.subtitle: One account, one partner, ten tankards. The experiment be simple, the result hopefully significant, arrr.
register.footer: Dry grog be welcome too. We count tankards, not how many sheets to the wind.
register.displayNameHint: This be how ye appear in yer crew and on the scoreboard.
register.emailHint: Only for signin'. Never shown to the seven seas.
register.passwordHintRemaining: At least {min} characters ({remaining} to go). A whole sentence works fine.
register.eventCodeHint: It be on the invitation or at the gangway.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Pick a new password. The link works only once and be valid for 30 minutes.
reset.done: New password saved. All old sessions be sunk.
reset.linkUnusable: This link be invalid, expired or already used. Ask the tournament officers for a new one.

profile.title: Profile
profile.mustChangeBody: Yer account uses a temporary password. Set yer own now before ye carry on.
profile.changePasswordNote: After the change ye be signed out on all other devices.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices be signed out.

home.preparingBody: The tournament officers be mixing the potions. Come back soon.
home.forbidden: Ye lack the permission for that page. Ye were sent back to the harbour.

team.title: Me crew
team.lockedBanner: Crews be locked. Changes only via the tournament officers.
team.signupSoonBody: The tournament officers open crew signin' shortly. Go grab yer lab partner, arrr!
team.noTeamBody: Ye be in no crew. Tell the tournament officers if that be a mistake.

create.title: Found a crew
create.subtitle: Ye'll get an invite code for yer duo.
create.mottoPlaceholder: Precise down to the last tankard
create.created: Crew founded! Now invite yer partner.

invite.title: Invite yer partner
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Write the code down, matey.
invite.rotated: New code generated. The old code be useless now.

leave.lastMember: Ye be the last member: if ye leave, the crew be dissolved and the name be free again.
leave.otherStays: Yer partner stays in the crew and can invite someone new.

edit.nameLockedHint: After the crew lock, only the tournament officers can change it.

logo.label: Crew flag
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, max. {maxMb} MB. Cropped to a square.
logo.tooLarge: The image be larger than {maxMb} MB.

joinPage.title: Join crew
joinPage.rateLimitedBody: Too many invalid codes were tried from this network. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
joinPage.notFoundBody: This code be invalid or renewed. Ask yer crew for the current link.
joinPage.alreadyInTeam: Ye be already in the crew «{name}».
